Shipping policy

Thank you very much for choosing RUCHS. The purpose is to deliver your products safely, quickly, and smoothly.

Order Processing Time

All orders are processed within 3–7 business days .

Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next working day.

Delivery Time

Standard delivery within India typically takes 3–7 business days depending on your location.

Remote areas may take slightly longer.

You will receive a tracking link once your order is shipped.

Shipping Charges

Shipping charges will be calculated and shown at checkout.

Free shipping may apply during special promotions.

Order Tracking

Once your order is dispatched, you will receive an email/SMS with:

Tracking ID

Courier partner name

Live tracking link

Please allow up to 24 hours for the tracking information to update.

Incorrect Address

We are not responsible for:

Orders shipped to an incorrect address provided by the customer

Failed delivery attempts due to customer unavailability

If the order returns to us due to an incorrect address or non-collection, re-shipping charges will apply.

Delays

Shipping delays may occur due to:

Weather conditions

Festive seasons

Courier partner issues

Unexpected logistics delays

We will always try our best to support you in such cases.

Order Not Received

If your tracking shows “delivered” but you haven't received the parcel:

Please check with neighbors/security/courier offices.

If still unresolved, contact us within 24 hours of the delivery update so we can help.

Contact Us

For any shipping-related questions, reach us at: ruchsofficial@gmail.com
